'''Honey wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]].<ref name="GG10" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Honey wine was mentioned in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''. The book was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" />
